intuition: Each root-to-leaf number is formed by appending each node digit to the prefix accumulated from its ancestors.

brute_force.approach: Build a string for every root-to-leaf path and convert each string to an integer.

optimal.approach: Carry the numeric prefix down the tree using prefix * 10 + node.val, and add it at each leaf.

edge_cases: A single-node tree contributes that digit.
The input values are decimal digits.
